habitat_rules.eelgrass: underwater, -8.5 < h < -0.5 m, slope < 8 deg  (Zostera marina, documented 0.5-8.5 m)
habitat_rules.ceramium: underwater, -12 < h < -0.8 m, slope < 14 deg  (Ceramium virgatum, the pink red alga in the live camera)
habitat_rules.kelp: underwater, -20 < h < -0.5 m, slope >= 8 deg  (Laminaria/Saccharina on hard substrate, 0-20 m)

note: Placement derived from measured depth and slope, not painted. The splat map's 'vegetation' channel is LAND vegetation and is zeroed underwater, so these habitats are computed here from the same source data.
